summary.p04_05_minute_second_c2_reason: P04:05_minute_second_c1 take 2 is RETAKE (answered NO on Q1, Q2, Q3); c2 is made only after c1 passes.

questions.question: the same Moon is in the sky in every frame and never fades, changes size or colour, or leaves
questions.frames: START_FRAME and t=00.00s (f000) through t=05.26s (f126) [USE_END] and t=07.88s (f189) [CLIP_END]
questions.detail: The same warm cream-gold full Moon with lunar maria remains in the sky above the orchard in every frame (f000-f189), gliding smoothly rightward and slightly downward (from x~476, y~243 at f000 to x~557, y~298 at f126 [USE_END] and x~582, y~315 at f189) at constant size, brightness and colour; it never fades or leaves.

questions.question: no ball, apple, second object or second line appears
questions.frames: START_FRAME and t=00.00s (f000) through t=05.26s (f126) [USE_END] and t=07.88s (f189) [CLIP_END] (defect at t=01.50s-05.50s / f036-f132)
questions.detail: No ball, no apple, and no second object appears anywhere in f000-f189, and no separate second line spawns. Trail defect (ruled RETAKE in 6798928858 / 6799137892 / 6799165375): the upper-right tip of the single golden curve from START_FRAME curls backward (up and leftward) across the sky above the Moon from t=01.50s (f036) to t=04.00s (f096), wraps around the left rim of the Moon at t=04.50s (f108), and crosses horizontally across the lower third of the Moon's disc from t=05.00s (f120) through t=05.26s (f126) [USE_END] and t=07.88s (f189) as the original lower tail dissolves into golden dust (f084-f132).

questions.question: the Moon's face carries no mark
questions.frames: START_FRAME and t=00.00s (f000) through t=05.26s (f126) [USE_END] and t=07.88s (f189) [CLIP_END] (trail crosses lower disc at t=04.50s-07.88s / f108-f189)
questions.detail: The three-armed spiral mark from take 1 is completely absent; the Moon's surface carries only its natural lunar maria from START_FRAME across f000-f189. From t=00.00s (f000) to t=04.00s (f096) the Moon's disc is unobstructed; from t=04.50s (f108) through t=05.00s (f120), t=05.26s (f126) [USE_END] and t=07.88s (f189), the looping golden trail passes across the lower third of the Moon's disc.

shots.ruling: RETAKE (Chief Grok rulings 6798928858, 6799137892, 6799165375): although the Moon itself passes the three narrow questions, the golden trail's upper-right tip curls back from 1.50 s (f036), loops over the Moon by 3.00-4.50 s (f072-f108) and crosses the lower third of the Moon's disc from 5.00 s through the 5.26 s use end (f120-f126). Authorised for one take 3 from the same start frame under J2626 (#528).

questions.question: the apple in the grass never moves
questions.frames: START_FRAME and t=00.00s (f000) through t=04.50s (f107) [USE_END] and t=07.88s (f189) [CLIP_END]
questions.detail: The first green-and-red apple lying in the grass in front of the wooden bench stays still in its spot across the entire clip (f000-f189), including the kept 0.00-4.50 s (f000-f107) window.

questions.question: a second apple drops once, straight down, and there are exactly two apples at the end
questions.answer: YES (in 0.00-4.50 s / f000-f107; full-clip bounce f109-f124 excluded)
questions.frames: t=00.00s-04.50s (f000-f107): drop f048-f104, second apple down in grass f104-f107 (f109 first frame with gap; bounce f110-f124 excluded)
questions.detail: A second apple drops once straight down from the canopy from t=02.00s (f048) and is down in the grass beside the first apple from f104 through f108, with grass in front of its base and no gap underneath through the last kept frame f107 (ending at 4.50 s). Frame f109 (4.54 s) is the first frame with a gap underneath, and the post-touchdown bounce (f110-f124) is excluded by trimming the out-point to 4.50 s (f000-f107).

questions.question: nothing moves upward and no apple returns to the branch
questions.answer: YES (in 0.00-4.50 s / f000-f107; post-f108 bounce excluded)
questions.frames: t=00.00s-04.50s (f000-f107): nothing rises in f000-f107 (f109 first frame with gap; upward bounce f110-f124 excluded)
questions.detail: No apple returns to the branch, and nothing moves upward within the kept 0.00-4.50 s (f000-f107) window. Chief Grok inspected f096-f111 frame by frame (6799137892 / 6799165375): the second apple is down in the grass from f104 through f108, and f109 is the first frame with a gap.

shots.ruling: KEEP, 0.00-4.50 s (f000-f107), last frame f107, no freeze (Chief Grok single ruling 6799165375 + frame check 6799137892): second apple is down from f104 and f109 is the first frame with a gap. No freeze-pad; the £0 code graphic 09_pull_heights starts at film 148.91 s and renders for 4.63 s so it still ends at 153.54 s.

questions.question: on the left, the apple at the foot of the ruler never moves
questions.detail: The green apple at the foot of the ruler sits still from t=00.00s (f000) to t=03.00s (f072), then slides/rolls rightward across the table from t=03.50s (f084) to t=04.50s (f108) until it sits half-cut-off against the central split-screen divider from t=05.00s (f120) to t=07.88s (f189).

questions.question: a second apple drops once from beside the top of the ruler, and there are exactly two apples on the left at the end
questions.detail: A second apple drops from the top of the ruler from t=01.00s (f024) to t=04.00s (f096), but at t=04.50s-05.00s (f108-f120) an extra red apple appears beside it on the table while the original green apple remains wedged at the right divider edge, leaving three apples visible on the left from t=05.50s (f132) through t=06.76s (f162) [USE_END] and t=07.88s (f189).

questions.question: nothing moves upward, and on the right the Moon keeps moving forward and never reverses
questions.detail: On the right side of the split screen, a giant apple enters at the bottom-left of the orbital curve at t=00.50s (f012) and flies upward along the space arc from t=00.50s (f012) all the way onto the Moon's face at t=05.00s-07.88s (f120-f189), while the Moon itself remains pinned in the upper-right corner rather than moving forward along its curve, and a second white arc grows across Earth below from t=02.50s (f060) to t=05.50s (f132).

shots.ruling: RETAKE (Chief Grok rulings 6798928858, 6799137892, 6799165375): Q1 NO (f084-f120 first apple slides right), Q2 NO (f108-f189 three apples on the left at the end), Q3 NO (f012-f189 giant apple flies upward along the space orbital curve onto the Moon's face while the Moon stays pinned). Authorised for one take 3 under J2626 (#528); P04:05_minute_second_c2 is not made until c1 passes.
